triggering_merge_pr.title: Update Testcontainers to resolve SSH.NET vulnerabilities
triggering_merge_pr.author: mitchdenny

candidate_merges.message: Update Testcontainers to resolve SSH.NET vulnerabilities (#20603) ## Description Repository restores report high-severity SSH.NET vulnerabilities through the test dependency chain `Testcontainers.RabbitMq 4.8.1 -> Testcontainers 4.8.1 -> SSH.NET 2024.2.0`. Other Testcontainers-based suites share this dependency; the production RabbitMQ packages do not reference SSH.NET. Upgrade the Testcontainers family to 4.15.0, which resolves SSH.NET 2026.0.0 and addresses: - [GHSA-mggc-4xg6-vcxf](https://git
